profiles.name: Arcanea Core
profiles.premise: Machine-readable inheritance profile for the locked Arcanea cosmology; it introduces no independent lore claims.

combinationRules: Every assembly inherits the highest Gate requirement among its components.
No assembly may add a new primary Element or bypass the locked rank ladder.

worldRules: Derived Expressions remain compositions of locked Elements and never become new Elements.
Artifacts grant bounded capabilities but never opened Gates, rank, cultural mastery, or moral authority.
Nero and Void remain generative potential; Shadow alone is the corrupted severance of Spirit from Void.

portals.importRule: Imported artifacts are re-evaluated against local materials, Gate access, and prohibited domains.
portals.exportRule: Exported artifacts retain source-world provenance, rights, price, and canon-scope metadata.

profiles.name: Darkenia
profiles.premise: An artifact civilization democratized magical access faster than it distributed discipline, context, repair capacity, and responsibility.

combinationRules: Licensed assemblies must expose their Core, Keystone, cumulative prices, and emergency separation path.
Permanent affinity imprinting requires consent, Sacred-or-higher authority, and an ecological counterweight.
Shadow components are quarantined and cannot participate in public assemblies.

worldRules: Keys and Vessels are common while Bridges and Engines determine institutional and geopolitical power.
Gate Debt is recorded, priced, inherited, disputed, and never represented as a genuinely opened Gate.
Living Verdance artifacts retain consent and can refuse owners, cities, or assemblies that violate ecological reciprocity.
Darkenia's darkness arises from institutions, scarcity, Malachar's Shadow contamination, and choice rather than from Nero or Void.

portals.importRule: Imports enter quarantine until their source laws, substrates, agency, prices, and rights lineage are legible.
portals.exportRule: Exports carry an indelible Darkenia debt and provenance record that destination worlds must preserve.

profiles.name: Community World Template
profiles.premise: A cloneable profile that lets communities create distinct magical ecologies without forking the Arcanea cosmic kernel.

combinationRules: Community assemblies remain experimental until their world profile and every component pass human review.

worldRules: Replace this rule with a local consequence that creates story rather than decorative lore.
Replace this rule with a local access institution, taboo, or repair practice.

portals.importRule: Cross-world imports are disabled until the community defines an explicit compatibility policy.
portals.exportRule: Cross-world exports are disabled until creator license and provenance rules are complete.
